ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
en: O God, to Thee belongs praise for Thy excellent accomplishment
and for Thy trial which Thou hast turned away from me!

ar: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
en: But make not my share of Thy mercy the well-being which Thou hast quickly granted to me,

ar: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
en: lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

ar: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
en: If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

ar: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
en: should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

ar: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
en: then set before me what Thou hadst set behind and set behind me what Thou hadst set before!
For that which ends in annihilation is not great
and that which ends in subsistence is not little.
And bless Muhammad and his Household!
